boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission museum outings in Washington, DC, suitable for an under-21 group.

cards.title: Browse American History Together
cards.subtitle: 1300 Constitution Ave. NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Meet outside the Constitution Avenue entrance, choose one gallery each, then compare the objects or stories that held your attention.
cards.short_summary: A no-ticket Smithsonian gallery outing focused on U.S. history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Museum of American History at 1300 Constitution Ave. NW and says admission is free with no pass needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo — Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no pass is needed; the Smithsonian lists daily hours and a December 25 closure.

cards.title: Wander the Natural History Galleries
cards.subtitle: 10th St. & Constitution Ave. NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Use the museum’s public galleries for a self-guided loop; pause at a few specimens and trade observations before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A free Smithsonian visit centered on the natural world.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Museum of Natural History at 10th Street and Constitution Avenue NW as free with no pass needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo — Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no pass is needed; the Smithsonian lists daily hours and a December 25 closure.

cards.entity_name: National Museum of the American Indian
cards.title: Explore Native Heritage Galleries
cards.subtitle: 4th St. & Independence Ave. SW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Plan a self-guided visit around the museum’s public exhibitions, allowing time to read gallery context and discuss what you learned.
cards.short_summary: A free Smithsonian museum visit exploring Native history and culture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Museum of the American Indian in DC at 4th Street and Independence Avenue SW as free with no pass needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo — Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no pass is needed; the Smithsonian lists daily hours and a December 25 closure.

cards.title: Trace Flight and Space History
cards.subtitle: 650 Jefferson Dr. SW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Reserve the required free entry pass, then pick a few aircraft or spacecraft to examine and share what you notice.
cards.short_summary: A free, timed-entry Smithsonian outing about aviation and spaceflight.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Air and Space Museum at 650 Jefferson Drive SW and states that free timed-entry passes are required.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo — Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: Reserve a free timed-entry pass before visiting; the Smithsonian lists daily hours and a December 25 closure.

cards.title: Look Through Contemporary Art
cards.subtitle: Independence Ave. at 7th St. SW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Start with one floor or exhibition, take time with individual works, and use the museum’s public galleries as a conversation prompt.
cards.short_summary: A free Smithsonian contemporary-art museum visit.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the Hirshhorn Museum at Independence Avenue and 7th Street SW as free with no pass needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo — Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no pass is needed; the Smithsonian lists regular public hours and a December 25 closure.

cards.title: Spend Time with African Art
cards.subtitle: 950 Independence Ave. SW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Walk through the public galleries at an unhurried pace, selecting a work to discuss and reading its accompanying interpretation.
cards.short_summary: A free Smithsonian gallery visit dedicated to African art.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Museum of African Art at 950 Independence Avenue SW as free with no pass needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo — Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no pass is needed; the Smithsonian lists daily hours and a December 25 closure.

cards.title: Explore Asian Art Collections
cards.subtitle: 1050 Independence Ave. SW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Enter the East Building galleries, make a short self-guided route, and compare a few works from different periods or regions.
cards.short_summary: A free Smithsonian art-museum outing with East and West Building galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the Asian Art Museum East Building at 1050 Independence Avenue SW as free with no pass needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo — Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no pass is needed; the Smithsonian lists daily hours and a December 25 closure.

cards.title: See Three Centuries of American Art
cards.subtitle: 8th and G Streets NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Meet at the shared museum building, choose a gallery sequence, and take a few minutes to compare how artists tell different stories.
cards.short_summary: A free Smithsonian American-art museum visit in Penn Quarter.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the Smithsonian American Art Museum at 8th and G Streets NW as free with no pass needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo — Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no pass is needed; the Smithsonian lists daily public hours and a December 25 closure.

cards.title: Read Portraits and Biography
cards.subtitle: 8th and G Streets NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Use the public portrait galleries for a slow lap; choose a sitter and image to discuss with your group before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A free Smithsonian museum visit built around portraiture and biography.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the National Portrait Gallery at 8th and G Streets NW as free with no pass needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo — Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no pass is needed; the Smithsonian lists daily public hours and a December 25 closure.

cards.title: Follow the Story of the Mail
cards.subtitle: 2 Massachusetts Ave. NE, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Take a self-guided tour through the public museum and pick an object, stamp, or mail story to share on the way out.
cards.short_summary: A free Smithsonian museum outing about U.S. postal history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithsonian lists the Postal Museum at 2 Massachusetts Avenue NE as free with no pass needed.
cards.source_title: Smithsonian Museums and Zoo — Hours and Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: General admission is free and no pass is needed; the Smithsonian lists daily hours and a December 25 closure.
